claims: Gothic Classic releases on July 28, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox.
Gothic II Complete Classic releases on September 29, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox.
Gothic 3 Classic releases on November 24, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox.
Gothic 1 Remake launches on June 5, 2026 on PS5.
Each classic title will retail for $29.99.
Pre-ordering the Gothic 1 Remake includes Gothic Classic as a free bonus on consoles.
Gothic Classic, Gothic II Complete Classic, and Gothic 3 Classic are "Classic" ports rather than full remakes.
Pre-orders for the Gothic Classic Trilogy are available through retailers like Video Games Plus.
Gothic 1 Remake offers an updated Unreal Engine 5 experience.
